BudgetLedger.description: Budget use so far (`budget_ledger/1.0`, PRD §29.3; A-004). Replaced, not mutated.
BudgetLedger.title: BudgetLedger

CandidateSpec.description: A candidate pipeline: preprocessing + features + model (`candidate/1.0`, PRD §0.4).
CandidateSpec.title: CandidateSpec

ChangeEncoding.description: Change encoding for named columns within the allowed encodings (PRD §19.3).
ChangeEncoding.title: ChangeEncoding

ColumnDecision.description: Planner decision for one listed column (PRD §12.3).
ColumnDecision.title: ColumnDecision

ColumnInfo.description: One column's normalized name, type, role, and data decisions (FR-ING-03, FR-ING-04).
ColumnInfo.title: ColumnInfo

ColumnOverride.description: A user override from the configure page (PRD §3.2 stage 2, FR-ING-04).
ColumnOverride.title: ColumnOverride

CompactColumn.description:
One column in the compact profile: aggregates only, no cell labels (PRD §9.4, A-005).

`q` = [min, p5, p25, p50, p75, p95, max]; absent in minimal mode.
CompactColumn.title: CompactColumn

CompactTarget.description: Target aggregates in the compact profile (PRD §26.2).
CompactTarget.title: CompactTarget

DropModel.description: Drop one model; the validator keeps ≥ 1 model (PRD §19.3).
DropModel.title: DropModel

EnsembleMember.description: One ensemble member and its weight (PRD §20.3).
EnsembleMember.title: EnsembleMember

EqualsParams.description: `equals`: numeric value only; categorical labels are never sent to the LLM (§14.3).
EqualsParams.title: EqualsParams

EqualsSpec.description: `equals`: 1 numeric/boolean input compared with a numeric value → boolean.
EqualsSpec.title: EqualsSpec

FinalResult.description: Frozen selection and its outputs (`final_result/1.0`, PRD §13.3, L-8).
FinalResult.title: FinalResult

HoldoutResult.description: One-time holdout scores (PRD §18.3, §26.9; L-7). `ci95` is [low, high] when present.
HoldoutResult.title: HoldoutResult

LeaderboardEntry.description:
One leaderboard row (`leaderboard_entry/1.0`, PRD §18.1).

`mean`, `std` (ddof=1) and `sem` must equal the values recomputed from `fold_scores`
(G-09 / T-EVL-01).
LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry

MetricSpec.description: A metric and its direction (`metric_spec/1.0`, PRD §10.2, §10.4).
MetricSpec.title: MetricSpec

NoParams.description: Parameters for ops that take none (any key is rejected).
NoParams.title: NoParams

PlannerOutput.description:
A modeling plan from the LLM or the rule-based planner (`plan/1.0`, PRD §12.3, §26.4).

Structural bounds live here; dataset-dependent checks (columns, availability, DSL types,
cost) are done by the plan validator (P11, §12.6).
PlannerOutput.title: PlannerOutput

ReallocateTuning.description: New tuning fractions over available models (PRD §19.3).
ReallocateTuning.title: ReallocateTuning

ReflectionProposal.description:
One bounded set of changes (`reflection/1.0`, PRD §19.3, §26.10).

Task, target, metric, folds, holdout, seeds, and budgets are not fields, so they cannot
be changed.
ReflectionProposal.title: ReflectionProposal

RestSummary.description: Summary of columns beyond the detailed list (PRD §9.4).
RestSummary.title: RestSummary

RowRemoval.description: A recorded row removal (no-silent-discard rule, PRD §8.6).
RowRemoval.title: RowRemoval

RunWarning.description:
A structured warning (`warning/1.1`: + W-NEAR-CONSTANT, W-HIGH-CARDINALITY, PI-42).

Named `RunWarning` to avoid the builtin (PI-25).
RunWarning.title: RunWarning

Simplification.description: Resource simplifications, applied in this order (PRD §29.5).
Simplification.title: Simplification

SourceInfo.description: Uploaded file facts. `display_name` is sanitized display text only (PRD §24.2).
SourceInfo.title: SourceInfo

Stage.description: Run stages and graph nodes used for events, timings, and errors (PRD §13.2, §13.4).
Stage.title: Stage

ToggleClassWeight.description: Set class weighting for one model (PRD §19.3).
ToggleClassWeight.title: ToggleClassWeight

UnaryNumericSpec.description: `log1p`, `sqrt`, `square`: 1 numeric input (negatives → NaN for log1p/sqrt, A-007).
UnaryNumericSpec.title: UnaryNumericSpec

WarningCode.description: Every warning code used in the PRD (§8.2, §8.5–§8.7, §9.3, §11.1; A-008; PI-42).
WarningCode.title: WarningCode

description:
LangGraph run state (`state/1.1`: embeds `warning/1.1`; PRD §13.3). Small, serializable.

Large objects (DataFrames, OOF arrays, fitted pipelines) live in the worker's `RunContext`.
title: RunState
